stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs snap back with inflows after cold-wallet hack rattles custody confidence
stories.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs logged fresh inflows, according to Cointelegraph, with CryptoSlate reporting that seven different Bitcoin ETFs simultaneously turned positive after a prior $265 million mass exit. The rebound comes as a cold wallet hack has reignited debate over custody practices for digital assets.
stories.whyItMatters: ETF flow swings are a key gauge of institutional sentiment, and a custody scare landing right as flows reverse raises the stakes on how safely investor assets are actually held.
whatToWatch: Whether inflows hold or reverse again in coming sessions
Any regulatory or issuer response to the custody concerns raised by the hack
questions: What specifically caused the earlier $265 million outflow before the reversal?
Which cold wallet was hacked and does it affect ETF custodians directly?

sources.title: Bitcoin ETFs log inflows as cold wallet hack reignites custody debate
After suffering a brutal $265 million mass exit, seven different Bitcoin ETFs simultaneously roar back to life

stories.title: Bitcoin lags as global equities notch record highs amid yen-intervention jitters
stories.summary: CoinDesk reports Bitcoin and the broader crypto market failed to keep pace as global equity markets hit record highs. Cointelegraph adds that a US-related yen intervention has put Bitcoin and other risk assets on alert for potential liquidity disruption.
stories.whyItMatters: Bitcoin's underperformance against surging equities, paired with currency-market intervention risk, tests the asset's claim as a liquid, macro-resilient store of value.
whatToWatch: Whether Bitcoin narrows the gap with equities or falls further behind
Follow-through effects of yen intervention on global risk-asset liquidity
questions: Is the underperformance a rotation out of crypto or simply slower momentum?
How directly does yen intervention transmit to crypto liquidity conditions?

sources.title: Bitcoin, broader market fail to keep pace as global equities hit record highs
US yen intervention puts Bitcoin, risk assets on notice for liquidity flux

stories.title: Bitcoin holds near $64,000 as stocks hit records and Hormuz reopening nears
stories.summary: CoinDesk reports Bitcoin is trading flat around $64,000 even as stock indexes print fresh records and reports suggest a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz is approaching. Cointelegraph notes the S&P 500 pushed to a $70 trillion market cap milestone amid the same Hormuz reopening timeline.
stories.whyItMatters: A geopolitical resolution affecting oil-shipping routes typically eases macro risk premiums, and Bitcoin's flat reaction while equities rally raises questions about its current correlation to risk sentiment.
whatToWatch: Confirmation or collapse of the Hormuz reopening timeline
Whether Bitcoin breaks out of its $64,000 range once geopolitical clarity arrives
questions: What exactly is the status of the Hormuz deal and who are the parties involved?
Why isn't Bitcoin participating in the equity rally this geopolitical news is driving?

stories.title: Proposed 54% cut to Ethereum staking rewards could flip DeFi's favorite loop into a loss
stories.summary: CryptoSlate reports that a proposed 54% reduction in Ethereum staking rewards could undermine a popular DeFi leveraged-staking loop strategy, potentially turning it into a daily loss for participants if it passes. The piece frames this as a direct threat to yield strategies built around current issuance levels.
stories.whyItMatters: Leveraged staking loops have become a significant source of DeFi activity and demand for staked ETH; a reward cut steep enough to erase their profitability could trigger unwinding and liquidity shifts across DeFi.
whatToWatch: Whether the issuance-cut proposal advances toward implementation
Signs of leveraged-loop positions unwinding in anticipation of the change
questions: What is the exact mechanism and timeline for the proposed reward cut?
How much capital is currently deployed in the affected loop strategy?

sources.title: If Ethereum’s proposed 54% reward cut passes, DeFi’s favorite loop threatens to become a daily loss machine

stories.title: Circle shares rise as earnings beat offsets revenue miss; Arc blockchain wins Wall Street backing
stories.summary: CoinDesk reports Circle's stock jumped after the stablecoin issuer posted an earnings beat that outweighed a revenue miss. The report also notes Circle's Arc blockchain is gaining backing from Wall Street institutions.
stories.whyItMatters: Circle is a bellwether for stablecoin-sector health, and institutional buy-in for its Arc blockchain signals growing traditional-finance interest in stablecoin infrastructure.
whatToWatch: Further detail on which Wall Street firms are backing Arc and in what capacity
Circle's next earnings report for whether the revenue miss was a one-off
questions: What drove the revenue miss even as earnings beat expectations?
What specifically does 'Wall Street backing' for Arc entail—investment, partnership, or usage?

stories.title: New Ethereum proposal would zero out issuance once staked ETH hits $112 billion
stories.summary: CoinDesk reports a new Ethereum proposal would cut issuance to zero once the total value of staked ETH reaches $112 billion. The proposal is a technical change to Ethereum's monetary policy tied to staking participation thresholds.
stories.whyItMatters: Issuance policy directly affects ETH's supply dynamics and staking economics, making this a significant potential shift for validators and holders alike.
whatToWatch: Community and client-team discussion on whether the proposal advances
Current progress of staked ETH value toward the $112 billion threshold
questions: Who authored the proposal and what stage of Ethereum's governance process is it in?
How would a sudden move to zero issuance affect validator incentives?

sources.title: New Ethereum proposal would cut issuance to zero if staked ETH reaches $112 billion

stories.title: S&P awards top stability rating to BlackRock's tokenized reserve fund
stories.summary: Cointelegraph reports that S&P has given BlackRock's tokenized reserve fund its top stability rating. The rating covers the fund's structure as a tokenized product tied to reserve-style assets.
stories.whyItMatters: A top rating from a major agency for a tokenized fund from the world's largest asset manager lends credibility to tokenized real-world-asset products entering mainstream finance.
whatToWatch: Whether other rating agencies follow with similar assessments of tokenized funds
Growth in assets under management for BlackRock's tokenized fund following the rating
questions: What specific criteria did S&P use to evaluate a tokenized fund versus a traditional one?
Does the rating affect the fund's eligibility for institutional mandates?

stories.title: Coldcard hack prompts calls for a self-custody security overhaul, says Klippsten
stories.summary: CoinDesk reports that a hack affecting Coldcard hardware wallets has prompted Cory Klippsten to call for a broader overhaul of self-custody security practices. The incident has renewed scrutiny of how individuals secure their own private keys.
stories.whyItMatters: Self-custody is a core value proposition of Bitcoin, so a hardware-wallet security incident directly challenges the safety assumptions many holders rely on.
whatToWatch: Technical details on how the Coldcard hack was carried out
Any firmware updates or security recommendations issued in response
questions: What specifically was compromised—the device, a supply-chain link, or user practices?
How many users or how much value was affected by the hack?

stories.title: Glassnode: Bitcoin price metrics show longest capitulation stretch since FTX collapse
stories.summary: Cointelegraph reports that a basket of Bitcoin price metrics tracked by Glassnode is showing its longest capitulation phase since the FTX collapse. The on-chain analytics firm's data points to sustained bearish signals across multiple indicators.
stories.whyItMatters: Capitulation readings this extended are historically associated with market bottoms or prolonged weakness, making this a closely watched signal for the current cycle.
whatToWatch: Whether Glassnode's capitulation metrics begin to turn as price action evolves
Any accompanying shifts in exchange flows or holder behavior
questions: Which specific metrics make up Glassnode's capitulation basket?
Has this capitulation signal historically preceded a bottom or further downside?

stories.title: Blockchain gaming studio Proof of Play to shut down
stories.summary: Cointelegraph reports that Proof of Play is shutting down after its blockchain gaming thesis failed to pan out. The closure adds to a string of setbacks for play-to-earn and blockchain-based gaming projects.
stories.whyItMatters: The shutdown of a notable blockchain gaming studio underscores continued struggles for the sector to find sustainable product-market fit beyond speculative token incentives.

questions: What specifically caused the studio's thesis to fail—user retention, tokenomics, or funding?

stories.title: Bitcoin's '500-day rule' faces its biggest test yet
stories.summary: CoinDesk examines Bitcoin's so-called '500-day rule,' a market-cycle heuristic, noting that current price action presents its most significant test of that pattern to date. The piece frames this as a moment that could validate or undercut the rule's predictive track record.
stories.whyItMatters: Cycle-based heuristics like this shape trader expectations and positioning, so a high-profile test of one's validity matters for how the market reads current price behavior.
whatToWatch: Whether Bitcoin's price action in coming weeks confirms or breaks the pattern
Commentary from other analysts on the rule's reliability this cycle
questions: What exactly does the '500-day rule' predict and what is its historical track record?

stories.title: Forgd's crypto market-maker leaderboard lands on DefiLlama
stories.summary: Cointelegraph reports that Forgd has brought its market-maker leaderboard, which tracks crypto market-making activity, to data platform DefiLlama. The integration puts Forgd's rankings in front of DefiLlama's existing user base.
stories.whyItMatters: Greater transparency around market-maker performance and activity can help projects and traders better assess liquidity quality and counterparty behavior in crypto markets.
whatToWatch: How the leaderboard's methodology is received by market makers and projects
Whether other data platforms adopt similar market-maker transparency tools
questions: What metrics does Forgd use to rank market makers?
Does inclusion on DefiLlama change how projects select market-making partners?
